relazioni.citazione: Upon desolvation, this solvate transforms into VEN B, which is more thermodynamically stable than VEN A based on the melting points.
relazioni.note: Punti di fusione 169.5 °C (VEN B) e 145.6 °C (VEN A). Gli autori non parlano di monotropia o enantiotropia e non hanno una temperatura di transizione.

citazioni: All samples were gently homogenized with a mortar and pestle and placed in a thin layer on Petri dishes of appropriate sizes.
Based on preliminary experiments, the samples were then dried at 60°C under reduced pressure (20 mBar) for 24 h.
All samples were dried under fairly harsh conditions (20 mBar, 60°C, up to 2 days).
If the drying proved insufficient (stoichiometric ratio of API:solvent ≥ 1:0.1), the procedure was repeated.
Three different outcomes were observed:
(ii) Transformation to solvent-free venetoclax form A (VEN A). This is the case of VEN EA, MEK, mTHF, IPAC.
The samples were analysed by XRPD, solution 1H NMR and thermal methods.
eventi.note: Desolvatazione a 60 °C e 20 mbar: 24 h nel protocollo dei metodi, ripetuta se l'essiccamento era insufficiente (rapporto API:solvente >= 1:0.1); i risultati dicono 'up to 2 days'. Il tempo del singolo campione non e' detto: si riporta il protocollo (24 h). Condizioni piu' blande: «only partial desolvation» (non estratte, senza condizioni). Prodotto VEN A, struttura non risolta (cristallinita' troppo imperfetta per la polvere).
eventi.pretrattamento: omogeneizzato in mortaio, in strato sottile su capsule di Petri

citazioni: All samples were gently homogenized with a mortar and pestle and placed in a thin layer on Petri dishes of appropriate sizes.
Based on preliminary experiments, the samples were then dried at 60°C under reduced pressure (20 mBar) for 24 h.

If the drying proved insufficient (stoichiometric ratio of API:solvent ≥ 1:0.1), the procedure was repeated.
Three different outcomes were observed:
(ii) Transformation to solvent-free venetoclax form A (VEN A). This is the case of VEN EA, MEK, mTHF, IPAC.
The samples were analysed by XRPD, solution 1H NMR and thermal methods.
Spectral techniques have proven that there are the same hydrogen bonds in VEN A as in VEN MEK, and there are the same hydrogen bonds in VEN B as in VEN AN2.

The channel-type nature of VEN MEK means that the necessary changes in the conformation and orientation of venetoclax molecules during desolvation could be more minor, facilitating easier desolvation to VEN A.
eventi.note: Desolvatazione a 60 °C e 20 mbar: 24 h nel protocollo dei metodi, ripetuta se l'essiccamento era insufficiente (rapporto API:solvente >= 1:0.1); i risultati dicono 'up to 2 days'. Il tempo del singolo campione non e' detto: si riporta il protocollo (24 h). Condizioni piu' blande: «only partial desolvation» (non estratte, senza condizioni). Prodotto VEN A, struttura non risolta (cristallinita' troppo imperfetta per la polvere). MEK: solvato di canale, disolvato; i gruppi coinvolti (O10, N3-H, N5-H) sono dedotti dagli autori da FTIR e ssNMR (13C, 15N): 'likely', 'we can deduce'. Gli stessi legami H nel desolvato (A) e nel solvato madre.

If the drying proved insufficient (stoichiometric ratio of API:solvent ≥ 1:0.1), the procedure was repeated.
Three different outcomes were observed:
(iii) Transformation to solvent-free venetoclax form B (VEN B). This applies to VEN AN2.
The samples were analysed by XRPD, solution 1H NMR and thermal methods.
Spectral techniques have proven that there are the same hydrogen bonds in VEN A as in VEN MEK, and there are the same hydrogen bonds in VEN B as in VEN AN2.

From the calculation results and the cavity-type character of the solvate, we can infer that a significant reordering of venetoclax molecules can be expected during desolvation, requiring larger conformational and orientational changes.
eventi.note: Desolvatazione a 60 °C e 20 mbar: 24 h nel protocollo dei metodi, ripetuta se l'essiccamento era insufficiente (rapporto API:solvente >= 1:0.1); i risultati dicono 'up to 2 days'. Il tempo del singolo campione non e' detto: si riporta il protocollo (24 h). Condizioni piu' blande: «only partial desolvation» (non estratte, senza condizioni). Prodotto VEN B (con tracce di acetonitrile, 0.09 mol eq.), struttura non risolta (cristallinita' troppo imperfetta per la polvere). AN2 e' un cavity solvate: gli autori deducono (non misurano) un riordino significativo delle molecole; i gruppi coinvolti sono dedotti da FTIR e ssNMR. La distanza interplanare del primo picco XRPD forte cambia dell'1.13% (Tabella 4: 5.818 -> 5.752 Å).

citazioni: All samples were gently homogenized with a mortar and pestle and placed in a thin layer on Petri dishes of appropriate sizes.
All samples were dried under fairly harsh conditions (20 mBar, 60°C, up to 2 days).
Three different outcomes were observed:

(i) No transformation: the acetone (VEN AE) and dioxane (VEN DIO) solvates remained essentially intact under even our harshest drying conditions (20 mbar, 60°C, 48 h), with VEN AE releasing only ∼10% of its solvent and VEN DIO undergoing only partial desolvation.
The exceptional robustness of VEN AE likely stems from its cavity-type topology, which physically hinders solvent escape, coupled with its unique HBP profile
VEN AE, which partially desolvates upon drying, but does not transform, experiences the largest shrinkage of 5% in the (001) direction.
eventi.note: L'acetone libera solo circa il 10% del solvente e il solvato non si trasforma: la distanza interplanare (001) del primo picco XRPD forte si riduce del 5.01% dopo l'essiccamento (Tabella 4: 6.071 -> 5.767 Å; «largest shrinkage of 5% in the (001) direction»). Gli autori spiegano la stabilita' con la topologia a cavita' e con il sintone N5-H···O sulfonile (7), che 'blocca' la conformazione. Le forme A e B non si formano (a_possibili).
eventi.pretrattamento: omogeneizzato in mortaio, in strato sottile su capsule di Petri

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: this strongly preferred hydrogen-bond motif effectively ‘locks in’ the venetoclax conformation and prevents the molecular reorganization required for complete desolvation.

eventi.conflitto: Le conclusioni dicono «In general, the channel solvates desolvated to venetoclax form A, while the two cavity solvates either did not desolvate at all (acetone solvate) or transformed to venetoclax form B», ma VEN DIO e' un channel solvate (canali 2D) e nei risultati resta sostanzialmente intatto («undergoing only partial desolvation»). Si tiene la descrizione puntuale dei risultati (regola 2).

citazioni: The melting points of the forms VEN A and B are 145.6 and 169.5°C, respectively. The DSC/TGA plots can be found in Fig. S6.
The desolvation study identified two venetoclax forms: A (melting point 145.6°C) and B (169.5°C).
The samples were weighed in an aluminium pan (10 mg). The pan was covered and the measurement was carried out under a nitrogen gas flow of 50 ml min−1.
The range of investigated temperatures was 0 to 300°C with a heating rate of 10°C min−1.
eventi.note: Punto di fusione riportato senza dire se onset o picco; la tecnica e' la DSC dei metodi (DSC/TGA in Fig. S6). Crogiolo in alluminio 10 mg, «The pan was covered»: `coperchio: true`; se fosse chiuso, sigillato o forato non e' detto, quindi `crogiolo` resta vuoto.

citazioni: Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and solution 1H NMR were used (see Fig. S10 and Table S3 of the supporting information). TGA indicated a mass loss of 4.1%, corresponding to approximately 0.4 molar equivalents of ethyl acetate.
The samples were weighed in an aluminium pan (10 mg).
The range of investigated temperatures was from room temperature (approximately 20°C) to 200°C with a heating rate of 10°C min−1.
eventi.note: TGA del solvato di acetato di etile in polvere: perdita di massa del 4.1%, circa 0.4 equivalenti molari (1H NMR: circa 0.5). Il prodotto non e' caratterizzato (a = ignota). L'intervallo di T e' quello generale della TGA (da temperatura ambiente, circa 20 °C, a 200 °C); il testo non dice a che T avviene la perdita. Il campione era filtrato e 'gently dried under nitrogen'. Dati in Fig. S10 e Tabella S3 (supplementari).

citazioni: The 6 mm-diameter IDR discs were prepared by direct compression of approximately 50 mg of venetoclax.
IDR measurements were performed in 50 ml of phosphate buffer solution (pH 6.8) with the addition of 0.1% sodium dodecyl sulfate at a stirring speed of 100 rpm.
On comparison of post-dissolution discs to the starting material, no phase transitions were observed.
The IDR values of VEN A and B are comparable (11.7 and 12.1 µg min−1 cm−2).

descrizioni.testo: two intramolecular hydrogen bonds, (1) H–N1···O11 and (3) H–N3···O16, present in all the venetoclax structures
descrizioni.citazione: We can see that two intramolecular bonds marked as (1) and (3) are present in all the structures of venetoclax.
H—N1⋯O11 [(1)] carries the highest propensity, 0.93, reflecting its ubiquity and strong geometric preference for forming a five-membered ring.

descrizioni.testo: very conformationally flexible: the torsion angles not anchored by the intramolecular H bonds give a variety of conformations
descrizioni.citazione: we can see that VEN is still very conformationally flexible and the torsion angles unaffected by molecular bonding lead to a variety of conformations.

descrizioni.testo: torsions with the largest differences: A sulfonyl amide region, B ether O16 region, C piperazine region, D torsion between the piperazine and cyclohexene rings
descrizioni.citazione: Four torsions are highlighted, where there are the most significant differences: A – sulfonyl amide region, B – ether O16 region, C – piperazine region and D – torsion between the piperazine and cyclohexene rings.

descrizioni.testo: almost identical conformation in VEN MEK, VEN mTHF and VEN EA (isostructural); the other structures differ from each other
descrizioni.citazione: Three structures that have an almost identical conformation of VEN can be identified (VEN MEK, VEN mTHF, VEN EA; middle in Fig. 6 ▸), not surprisingly, these three have been confirmed as isostructural.

note: Sette solvati di venetoclax (VEN AN2, MEK, mTHF, EA, IPAC, DIO, AE) con struttura SCXRD, piu' due strutture gia' pubblicate (VEN H2O, VEN AN1) riprese in Tabella 2, e due forme senza solvente (VEN A, VEN B) ottenute per desolvatazione (sotto vuoto a 60 °C): le strutture di VEN A e VEN B non sono note. CCDC 2381780-2381786 sono dati come elenco di sette numeri senza dire a quale struttura vada ciascuno (l'ordine non e' dichiarato): restano a livello di articolo e non si attribuiscono per ordine. Nelle strutture triclinie il PDF scrive «P1»: ricostruito P-1 con ragionamento sui volumi (vedi note delle forme, `gruppo_spaziale_dedotto`). Il materiale di partenza e' venetoclax amorfo (Zentiva). Le condizioni di essiccamento piu' blande («Gentler conditions were also tested, but they resulted in only partial desolvation») sono senza dettagli e non sono estratte. La differenza fra cristallo singolo e polvere dell'acetato di etile (SQUEEZE 1:1 contro TGA/NMR 0.4-0.5) e' spiegata dagli autori con la manipolazione del campione («flash-cooled directly from the mother liquor» contro «filtered and gently dried under nitrogen»): interpretazione, non un evento osservato. Velocita' di dissoluzione intrinseca: l'abstract dice che la forma B ha una IDR piu' rapida di A («a faster intrinsic dissolution rate»), i risultati che i valori sono confrontabili («comparable (11.7 and 12.1 µg min−1 cm−2)»), le conclusioni «slightly faster»: si riportano i due valori in `molecole`. Calcoli (energia reticolare, energie di attacco, rugosita', propensione ai legami H, CSD-Particle, Solvate Analyser) e spettri FTIR/ssNMR: nell'extra. Il disegno dei legami H (1)-(7) e la tabella dei legami presenti in ogni struttura sono in Fig. 2 e Fig. 4 (figure): nel testo si leggono solo alcune strutture.
